newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian premier to sack trade minister.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian premier to sack trade minister.

text.p: Hungary's Prime Minister Gyula Horn will seek the ouster of his minister for trade and industry over a scandal involving illegal payments by the privatisation agency he controls, MTI news agency said on Sunday.
The dismissal of Tamas Suchman would require the approval of President Arpad Goncz.

The Hungarian government on Friday sacked the entire board of the privatisation agency APV, saying it had made irregular payments amounting to millions of dollars to lawyer Marta Tocsik, who negotiated with municipalities on APV's behalf.
The government spared Suchman, although opposition parties said he was responsible and should go.
Suchman, a member of the Socialist Party (MSZP), senior partner in the ruling coaliton, has been in charge of Hungary's privatisation process since early 1995.
